summary.name: Waterfall Data Enrichment (SuperAGI)
summary.one_liner: A lead-data enrichment service by SuperAGI that cascades a contact list through multiple premium data providers to fill in verified emails, phone numbers, and company details.
use_cases: Filling in missing emails for a sales lead list
Finding direct dial or mobile numbers for prospects
Adding company revenue and headcount to CRM records
Gathering job titles and seniority for outreach targeting
Improving fill rates when one data provider has no match
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a Waterfall Data Enrichment service from SuperAGI that sends a lead list through several premium data providers in sequence, moving to the next provider when one returns no match. It is said to return verified work emails, mobile numbers, and LinkedIn URLs for people, and revenue, employee count, and HQ location for companies. It also lists job titles and seniority levels. The stated workflow is upload, map, enrich, export. The page text is mostly marketing and the crawled content is a Reddit subreddit page, so the subreddit itself is a community forum where a user asks about a profile found online without consent.
notable: Cascades through multiple premium data providers in sequence until a match is found
Covers people data (verified emails, mobile numbers, LinkedIn URLs) and company data (revenue, headcount, HQ)
Simple upload, map, enrich, export workflow
caveats: Pricing and plans are not stated on the page
Relies on third-party premium data providers whose sources are not named
The page includes a user post about an unconsented online profile, so the subreddit content is not product documentation
